description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per catalogue — the payment buys one signed split-profile report for one submitted MCP tool catalogue: for the catalogue as a whole and for each tool, by tool name, the shares of its definition-token count carried by its name, its description, and its parameter schema, counted exactly under the pinned cl100k_base tokenizer and stated as shares only (the report contains no token count for any tool or for the catalogue, and no character count); and the groups of two or more tools whose parameter-schema serialisations are byte-identical under the published serialisation. The report states proportions and duplication of schemas only; it grades nothing. Submitted catalogues are processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the catalogue.

catalogue.description: The one tool catalogue to profile: a JSON array of tool entries, or an object carrying a tools array of the same form. Each entry must be a JSON object; name and description, when present, must be strings; inputSchema, when present, may be any JSON value. At most 200 tools and 262,144 request-body bytes. Processed in memory only and never stored.

name: split_profile_check
